policy.description: Offline annotated-region coverage, not complete object detection accuracy. Literal normalized aliases fixed before inspecting full results. Dense phrases are not reduced to nouns. Unknown labels and group Products/Fruits are excluded from semantic coverage; all predictions remain available for review.
policy.normalization: lowercase, strip whitespace, collapse internal whitespace; no substring matching
policy.matching: maximum-cardinality one-to-one bipartite matching within image and canonical label; candidates visited by descending IoU, prediction index breaks ties
limitations: Related views are not independent scenes.
THUD labels and model vocabulary/granularity differ; group annotations are not single instances.
A matched annotated box does not verify a region caption, material, contact, relation or stability.
Unmatched predictions are not automatically hallucinations: annotations may be incomplete.
No mAP: native tasks do not provide comparable calibrated class confidence scores here.
